rules.title: General Laws Part II, Title I, Chapter 186, Section 31: Notice to quit for nonpayment of rent
rules.requirement: A written notice to quit for nonpayment of rent must be accompanied by a form documenting repayment agreements and giving information on rental assistance, court rules and legal eviction restrictions, with a prominent statement that the notice is not an eviction. Courts may not accept a summary process filing for nonpayment without proof the form was delivered.
rules.penalty: Court may not accept a writ, summons or complaint for filing without proof of delivery of the form.
rules.status_basis: Appears in the General Laws as a current section.

coverage.summary: Applies to notices to quit for nonpayment of rent given to residential tenants.

rules.quoted_span: No court having jurisdiction over an action for summary process pursuant to chapter 239, including the Boston municipal court department, shall, in an eviction for nonpayment of rent for a residential dwelling unit, accept for filing a writ, summons or complaint without proof of delivery of the form required under this section.
